name: llmslim
description: The context layer for production AI agents: local-first context planning, compression and runtime for LLM apps.

paragraphs: The context layer for production AI agents. This repository is LLMSlim Core (v0.11.0, MIT): local-first context planning and compression that fits prompts, conversation history, RAG, memory, and tool schemas into real token budgets while preserving instructions and execution boundaries.
Live Studio Playground • Documentation • Sarvam Integration • Benchmarks • Changelog
LLMSlim Holographic Engine: Multi-stage token compression condensing sparse context streams into dense information cores with zero contract mutation.
features: Financial Tax: Re-sending large prompts on every turn means you pay for the same input tokens again and again.
Latency Bottleneck: Large prompts inflate Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and queue times.
Lost-In-The-Middle Syndrome: Models can miss or misuse information buried in the middle of long contexts.
Security Risks: Untrusted RAG content can smuggle indirect prompt injections into system instructions.

requirements.text: Running it needs no API key, model, or network call:

The v0.6.0 release adds explainable per-item decisions, explicit infeasibility reporting, post-plan validation, token and cost telemetry, policy presets, and optional Sarvam AI, Zoho, and MongoDB integrations while keeping the base installation local-first and provider-neutral.
It needs a bearer API key to listen beyond localhost.
